in_hebrew.name: Jayce
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jayce הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Jayce is derived from the English word ‘jace’, which is a variant of ‘jay’, which is derived from the Middle English word ‘jay’, meaning ‘joy’ or ‘rejoice’. Jay is itself derived from the Old French ‘gai’, which means ‘happy’ or ‘joyful’. In the Christian context, Jayce can be seen as a symbol of the joy and rejoicing that comes from a deep faith and relationship with God.
